result:
The verdict is **pass**: one new line in `Servex/agents/policy.js` lets future voice masterminds spawn masterminds without a special grant. It only takes effect after Servex restarts, and the brief deliberately puts that off, so retrying the page and AI masterminds still waits on the restart.

I traced the rule by hand but couldn't re-run `policy.test.mjs` from a scratch copy, because it needs `express` and linking the main `node_modules` is blocked. The first review recorded 61 checks passing.

The report has six minor notes and no fixes:
- **Doc wording:** `Servex/agents/doc/architecture.md` says a task mastermind may spawn only a mastermind, a minion or a helper. It can actually spawn more, the way a manager can.
- **Granted by name:** the right to spawn masterminds goes to any agent whose id starts with `mastermind-`. It's worth checking that only real masterminds get that prefix.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/spawn-policy/review.md`.
